svg.aria-label: CloudWatch Spring Boot metrics and logs components
svg.text: Spring Boot creates separate coroutine operations for CloudWatch metrics, CloudWatch Logs, and explicit Micrometer snapshots.

g.text: Default publish methods require configured names; explicit-name methods can pass them per call.
The helper reads Micrometer meters only when application code invokes publish.

svg.text: Metrics, logs, and Micrometer snapshots share AWS defaults but stay separate operation surfaces.
